cv_sections.summary:
If a task has to be done twice, it should be automated.
I turned a 100GB+ manual data bottleneck into an autonomous
ETL pipeline that reduced operational effort by 80%. At Microsoft,
I applied this "automation-first" philosophy to the Azure Dedicated
GPU Cap Service, building Golang services that slashed request
latency by 15%. I build the high-performance "plumbing" that allows
AI and cloud infrastructure to scale without friction.
I am a Software Developer specialized in Distributed Systems and
Cloud-Native Architectures. I bridge the gap between complex
backend infrastructure and tangible user impact. With an MS in
Computer Science (GPA 3.91) and experience at Microsoft, I bring
"Big Tech" rigor and a scrappy, founding-engineer mindset to every
project.
Technical Pillars
Scalable Backend Engineering: Building low-latency, high-throughput
services (Go, C++, Java). I thrive on high-concurrency challenges
and stateless service design.
Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Expert in AWS and Azure, leveraging
Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform for "five-nines" availability.
AI & Automation: Integrating OpenAI Whisper into production SaaS
and building event-driven automation to eliminate operational "toil."
Impact & Metrics
• Microsoft: Optimized Azure GPU workloads, achieving a 15%
latency reduction and 20% manual intervention decrease via custom
Logic App and Python automation.
  Page 1 of 3
   
• ECare Medical: Architected a 0-to-1 multi-tenant SaaS platform.
Integrated NLP pipelines to reduce clinical documentation time by
40% and improved UI efficiency by 18%.
• UH Data Science Institute: Automated grading/reporting for 500+
researchers, cutting administrative time by 40% while managing an
HPC cluster.
• Data Analytics: Validated 50,000+ records at Action Tesa,
identifying a 15% demand increase for regional forecasting.
Current Mission
I am scaling the infrastructure powering the AI revolution. I'm eager
to connect with builders passionate about MLOps, distributed
systems, and cloud computing. Let’s connect to drive your next
major scale event.
Keywords: Backend Engineering, Distributed Systems, Azure,
AWS, Go, Python, C++, Java, MLOps, Cloud Infrastructure,
Docker, Kubernetes, REST API, Microservices, SQL Optimization,
TypeScript, React, System Design, Automation.
